items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: He used to have that on the space shelf. Well I knew the music. Because you see, he could read music, you know.

ctx.x: Because he could take a 16, a 64, a 32, And he had a second note from the eights. He knew all of that. Yeah. And he studied all that, you see. But he, Mama says it was after he went away. He played very well, even before he studied that, he must have played very well. Yeah.
And we know that the Levita had stack of music. Well he could read music. Oh yeah. Everybody knows that. Oh yeah. Yes.

He used to have that on the space shelf. Well I knew the music. Because you see, he could read music, you know. But he would take, to hold his music on that little horn there, a clothespin. I said, what, you gonna wash tonight? He said, no. He said, no, I wanna hold up the fans going my music on. Oh yeah, yeah.
